remarks: Welcome to Norwalk! Ranked by Fortune Magazine as one of the best places to live in America... You. Will. Fall. In. Love! This one-of-a-kind condo complex is nestled in a private enclave... just minutes from everything a top ranked city has to offer! Light, bright and spacious... you'll lose your breath to the soaring ceilings, open layout, and main level ensuite. Tastefully updated with designer cabinets, granite countertops, and stainless-steel appliances... style and elegance shines through! From the renovated bathrooms (boasting beautiful tile work, updated fixtures, and a dash of wow) to the amazing upper-level loft (possible 3rd bedroom or work from home studio).  You'll have everything you've been looking for.  This exclusive pet friendly complex boasts only 6 units, is professionally managed, and has all utilities included (except electricity). Just a hop and skip to New York City...you'll be located next to the Westport Avenue Corridor... Less than 5 minutes from Norwalk's Hospital, the Metro North Train Station, and I-95. Stroll through the Norwalk green or head to the beach with your yearly beach pass (no charge). From the Sono Collection Mall to the Maritime Aquarium, there is something for everyone close by. Additional amenities for this corner unit include: central air, washer / dryer in unit, private outdoor balcony, attached garage, and Stew Leonards grocery store just a few blocks away! Don't let this one pass you by schedule your viewing today!
